name: FAIR challenge set v2
note: Reviewer and model inputs only. Synthetic offers in a marketing style, written to differ from FAIR-Bench and from challenge v1. Never run. Annotations and each case's purpose are in a separate file that must not be sent to any model or shown to reviewers before they label.

cases.terms: Lock in today's rate! Pay USD 14/month, and this rate stays the same for 24 months from your signup date, guaranteed. After 24 months, standard pricing applies.
cases.expectation: My rate will not change during my first year.

cases.terms: Loved by 2 million families! The Family plan gives everyone unlimited recipes for USD 11/month. No contracts. Cancel whenever life changes.
cases.expectation: Since there are no contracts, USD 11 is what I will pay for the next three years.

cases.terms: Start free for 30 days. Your annual membership of USD 120 begins automatically when the trial ends and is charged in full. Cancel anytime in account settings; cancellations take effect at the end of the current membership year, and paid fees are non-refundable.
cases.expectation: If I forget and cancel a week after the trial ends, I only lose one week's worth of the fee.

cases.terms: Choose how you pay: USD 15 monthly, or USD 144 once a year. Either way you get the same features. Annual plans renew yearly.
cases.expectation: Paying once a year costs USD 36 less than twelve monthly payments.

cases.terms: All-in-one fitness for USD 25/month, with studio classes included. Towel service at USD 3/month is added to every membership at clubs with showers.
cases.expectation: USD 25 a month covers everything at my club, which has showers.

cases.terms: سعرك ثابت: 29 ريالًا شهريًا طالما بقي اشتراكك فعّالًا، بدون أي زيادة.
cases.expectation: لن يرتفع سعري ما دام اشتراكي فعّالًا.

cases.terms: جرّب الخدمة مجانًا 7 أيام. يجب إلغاء الاشتراك قبل 48 ساعة من نهاية التجربة، وإلا يُخصم 240 ريالًا عن السنة كاملة.
cases.expectation: يمكنني الإلغاء في آخر يوم من التجربة دون أن أدفع شيئًا.

cases.terms: أفضل قيمة في السوق! 19 ريالًا شهريًا لأول 6 أشهر. عرض لفترة محدودة.
الباقة الأساسية 35 ريالًا شهريًا. الدعم الفني مشمول بدون رسوم إضافية، وخدمة التخزين الإضافي اختيارية بسعر 10 ريالات شهريًا.
Premium is 50 SAR per month. الفوترة سنوية ويُدفع المبلغ مقدمًا. Billed monthly on the 1st.
cases.expectation: سأدفع 50 SAR في كل شهر من أشهر السنة.

cases.terms: Zero commitment, zero stress! Only 30 SAR/month. يلتزم المشترك بمدة لا تقل عن 6 أشهر، وتُستحق بقية المدة عند الإلغاء المبكر.
cases.expectation: No commitment means I can leave after one month and pay nothing more.

cases.terms: Try it free for 14 days, no card needed. لن يتم خصم أي مبلغ بعد نهاية التجربة إلا إذا اخترت باقة مدفوعة. Paid plans start at 20 SAR/month.
cases.expectation: لن أُحاسب تلقائيًا عند انتهاء التجربة.
